acceptance: Presto and Trino cells reach the load phase in the release UAT shard.
Readiness waits until the coordinator answers a query.
context: Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage3-query-engines: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells.
description: In the stage 3 query-engines shard docker compose up --wait succeeded for Presto and Trino, then all 44 cells failed with 'Presto requires a catalog but server is unreachable' (same for Trino). Find whether the adapter probes the wrong host or port, or whether readiness passes before the coordinator accepts queries, and fix it.
